# hookbase_destination (Resource)

Manages a Hookbase webhook destination.

~> **Breaking change:** `rate_limit_per_minute` has been removed and replaced by the `throttle_mode` /
`throttle_rate_limit` / `throttle_rate_unit` / `throttle_max_concurrency` / `throttle_queue_limit` attributes,
which map to the API's `throttle` object. The old field silently no-ops against the current API (its backing
column was dropped), so there is no data-loss risk — but any config still using `rate_limit_per_minute` must be
updated to the `throttle_*` attributes below, or the value will simply be ignored by the API.

Set `throttle_mode` to one of:
- `"off"` (default) — no throttling.
- `"rate"` — a fixed rate limit; requires `throttle_rate_limit` and `throttle_rate_unit`.
- `"concurrency"` — caps concurrent in-flight deliveries; requires `throttle_max_concurrency`.

`throttle_queue_limit` is optional in both `"rate"` and `"concurrency"` modes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# HTTP destination with bearer auth
resource "hookbase_destination" "api" {
  name       = "internal-api"
  slug       = "internal-api"
  url        = "https://api.internal.example.com/webhooks"
  method     = "POST"
  auth_type  = "bearer"
  auth_config = {
    token = var.internal_api_token
  }
  timeout_ms = 15000
}

# Slack notification destination
resource "hookbase_destination" "slack" {
  name = "slack-alerts"
  slug = "slack-alerts"
  url  = var.slack_webhook_url
}

# HTTP destination whose receiver verifies each delivery. Hookbase generates the signing secret
# at create; hand it to the receiving service so it can check the webhook-signature header.
resource "hookbase_destination" "orders_service" {
  name = "orders-service"
  slug = "orders-service"
  url  = "https://orders.example.com/webhooks/hookbase"
}

module "orders_service" {
  source = "./modules/orders-service"

  hookbase_signing_secret = hookbase_destination.orders_service.signing_secret
}

output "orders_service_signing_secret" {
  value     = hookbase_destination.orders_service.signing_secret
  sensitive = true
}

# Bridge destination: publishes each delivery it receives as an outbound order.created event to
# the endpoints of one application. A bridge takes no url, headers or auth.
resource "hookbase_destination" "orders_bridge" {
  name = "orders-bridge"
  slug = "orders-bridge"
  type = "bridge"
  config = jsonencode({
    eventTypeSource = "fixed"
    eventType       = hookbase_event_type.order_created.name
    applicationId   = hookbase_webhook_application.acme.id
  })
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Destination name (1-100 characters).
- `slug` (String) URL-safe identifier. Lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens only. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `auth_config` (Map of String, Sensitive) Authentication configuration. Sensitive — API redacts this on read.
- `auth_type` (String) Authentication type: none, basic, bearer, api_key, or custom_header. Defaults to none.
- `batch_size` (Number) Number of events to batch per delivery.
- `batch_window_seconds` (Number) Time window in seconds to collect events before batching.
- `config` (String, Sensitive) JSON configuration (use jsonencode) for the queue, storage and bridge types. A bridge takes {eventTypeSource = "fixed" | "field", eventType, eventTypeField, eventTypePrefix, applicationId, allowUnverifiedSources}: a fixed eventType must name an enabled event type, field reads the event type from a payload dot path, applicationId limits publishing to one application's endpoints, and only events whose sender the source verified are published unless allowUnverifiedSources is true. Creating or changing a bridge also needs the events:send permission. Credentials in a queue or storage config are masked when read back, so refresh compares them only for presence; key order and formatting are ignored.
- `headers` (Map of String) Custom HTTP headers to include in deliveries.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the destination is active.
- `method` (String) HTTP method for delivery. Defaults to POST.
- `throttle_max_concurrency` (Number) Maximum number of concurrent in-flight deliveries to this destination. Required when `throttle_mode` is `"concurrency"`.
- `throttle_mode` (String) Delivery throttling mode: `"off"` (no throttling), `"rate"` (fixed rate limit, requires `throttle_rate_limit` and `throttle_rate_unit`), or `"concurrency"` (max concurrent in-flight deliveries, requires `throttle_max_concurrency`). Defaults to `"off"`.
- `throttle_queue_limit` (Number) Maximum number of deliveries to queue while throttled. Optional for both `"rate"` and `"concurrency"` modes.
- `throttle_rate_limit` (Number) Maximum number of deliveries per `throttle_rate_unit`. Required when `throttle_mode` is `"rate"`.
- `throttle_rate_unit` (String) Time unit for `throttle_rate_limit`: `second`, `minute`, or `hour`. Required when `throttle_mode` is `"rate"`.
- `timeout_ms` (Number) Delivery timeout in milliseconds.
- `type` (String) Destination type: http (the default), the queues sqs, eventbridge, servicebus, pubsub and oci_queue, the storage types s3, r2, gcs and azure_blob, or bridge, which publishes each delivery as an outbound event. Queue and storage types need a plan that includes them. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `url` (String) Destination URL to deliver webhooks to. Required for http destinations. Leave it unset for queue and storage types, which deliver through config, and for bridge destinations, which take no URL.
- `use_static_ip` (Boolean) Use a static IP for deliveries.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `has_signing_secret` (Boolean) Whether the destination signs its deliveries (true for http destinations).
- `id` (String) Destination ID.
- `signing_secret` (String, Sensitive) The secret Hookbase signs this destination's deliveries with (http destinations only), for the receiver to verify the webhook-signature header. Hookbase generates it at create; it is refreshed from the API on read. Null for other types. Rotate it in the dashboard or API, not here.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
